reading_issues: JPG of a SnowPilot graph (994x840), depth-from-surface axis (6.044 px/cm, 0 at y=157, 90 at y=701) with an axis break above the label HS 157; heights converted as 157 - depth, so the pit bottom is 67 cm above ground. Square-with-slash glyph read as DF with secondary FC based on the test text 'In DF/FC'. 20-48 cm depth layer has a sloped hardness bar (layer mean recorded). 'x2' read as count 2.
